Vendored third-party libraries and fonts, loaded locally instead of from a CDN at runtime.
Each library was taken unmodified from the npm registry package named below.

openseadragon/
  Package:  openseadragon 4.1.1 (npm, published 2024-04-01)
  Files:    build/openseadragon/openseadragon.min.js, build/openseadragon/images/
  Licence:  BSD-3-Clause, see openseadragon/LICENSE.txt
  SHA-256:  7fdfdc04f10db24346c574104d74d442dadc80881912b3447d695397c629dc0c  openseadragon.min.js

jszip/
  Package:  jszip 3.10.2 (npm, published 2026-09-08)
  Files:    dist/jszip.min.js
  Licence:  MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later (dual), used under MIT, see jszip/LICENSE.markdown
  SHA-256:  7f839b2d4688b845c105ebf5d2f9803075f91ea0fe72bdaac176c3a04dd3d2c1  jszip.min.js

fonts/
  Families: Inter (variable, weight 100 to 900, version 4.001 in the name table)
            JetBrains Mono (variable, weight 400 to 800, version 2.211)
  Files:    latin and latin-ext subsets as WOFF2, declared in fonts/fonts.css
  Source:   copied unmodified on 2026-11-10 from other local repositories of the
            maintainer that already vendor them (the subsets Google Fonts
            distributes); nothing was downloaded for this step
  Licence:  SIL Open Font License 1.1, see fonts/OFL-Inter.txt and
            fonts/OFL-JetBrainsMono.txt

The OpenSeadragon SVG overlay plugin is not published on npm and is no longer
loaded. Its single use (an SVG layer that follows the viewport) is implemented
in js/utils/osdSvgOverlay.js.

To update: npm pack <package>@<version>, copy the files listed above, update
this file and the SHA-256 sums, and run the unit and e2e tests.
